<thought>Since searching by bond changes returned no results, I will search the template catalog using only the functional group that is formed in the forward reaction: “sulfonamides”. This should retrieve templates that describe the formation of a sulfonamide (the forward reaction of a sulfonyl chloride reacting with an amine). Once a template is found, I can obtain its mapped reaction SMILES (mapped_rxn) and its integer template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
